ModMetaData.name: Strata
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
My Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv Dont have discord: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/strata.html Roadmap: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/strata-roadmap.html
Dig down and build up a true multistory base - and let your colonists treat every level as one home.
EXCAVATED STAIRWELL Build a stairwell and your colonists carve out a new underground level beneath your base: a solid slab of living rock the same size as the map above, stacked exactly beneath it, ready to be mined into bedrooms, workshops, freezers, and vaults. Build another stairwell down there and keep going deeper. Every level is protected by thick rock roof - safe from drop pods, mortars, and weather. Stairwells are rotatable before placement.
TOWER STAIRWELL (BUILDING UP) Research building up, then frame a tower stairwell (or powered tower elevator) on the surface or on an upper floor. Completing it opens outdoor Level +N as a roof deck: you can only walk and build where the floor below is roofed, plus a plaza around the shaft. Open sky beyond the roof edge holds nothing - expand roofs downstairs to grow the deck. A second tower on the same floor joins that upper level. Page Up / Page Down jump between surface and upper floors.
GRAVSHIP (ODYSSEY) Build gravship stairwells on the ship substructure to open Strata levels below or above the deck. Linked A+/B+ floors travel with the launch and reattach when you land. Use gravship shafts on the ship - colony dig/tower stairs and elevators cannot be placed on substructure tiles.
ONE BASE, MANY FLOORS Other multi-level mods make each floor an island. Strata's fluidity engine relays your pawns between levels on their own:
- Idle colonists notice mining designations, blueprints, hauling, and bills on other levels and head down (or up) the stairs to do the work. - Hungry pawns will go find a meal on another level instead of starving next to a staircase. - Sleepy pawns walk home to their own bed - or to any level with a free bed to claim. - Haulers carry items through the stairwell to a level whose stockpiles accept them. - Work and Schedule tabs can list colonists across every linked level (Strata Levels toggle).
No micromanagement: you designate, they commute.
HEAT RISES, COLD FALLS Stairwells exchange temperature between the rooms at their top and bottom. A warm level below convects its heat upward quickly; a warmer level above only bleeds down slowly. Freezers belong downstairs - generator heat drifts up and out, and the cold pools where you put it. Buoyant gases (smoke, oxygen, methane, steam) rise through open shafts; heavy gases (deep gas, CO₂, black damp) sink to the level below.
LIVING BELOW Research living below for rock shoring pillars, gas airlocks, ore hoists, fungus farms, sump pumps, mine lamps, shaft bellows, and lime scrubbers. Shore wide halls against cave-ins, seal rooms, drain flood seep, and farm fungus in the dark.
BREATHE DEEP Underground levels run a full atmosphere simulation. Burners emit smoke that pools in enclosed rooms. Hidden chambers hold pressurized deep gas - poisonous, flammable, and worth extracting with a gas well and deep-gas generator (or helixien pipes if VHGE is loaded). Colonists and plants consume oxygen and produce CO₂ in sealed spaces. Oxygen pumps, CO₂ scrubbers, shaft gas exchangers, canary cages, gas pipes, exhaust fans, and the gas overlay (play settings) keep the deep livable - or warn you when it is not.
MINE ATMOSPHERE Methane, black damp, fungal spores, and steam each behave differently underground, with counter buildings once you research mine atmosphere.
FLUID SHAFTS Optional cross-level junctions beside stairwells tie pipe networks between floors when the matching mods are loaded: Dubs Bad Hygiene plumbing, Dubs Central Heating, Rimatomics coolant, helixien gas, chemfuel, and crude oil.
EVENTS THAT KNOW WHICH WAY IS UP Underground levels are sealed rock, so the sky cannot reach them: solar flares, eclipses, toxic fallout, weather, and raids with no way in are suppressed below ground. What can reach you lives in the dark - infestations, cave-ins, breached gas pockets, gas firestorms, deep sieges, cave breakthroughs, rich ore nodes, and rare burrowing raiders. World quest sites (collapsed mine, sealed vault, geothermal vent) and optional ancient colony stairheads on the surface open multi-level adventures. Seal a stairwell to contain gas or bugs on one level.
THE DEEPER, THE STRANGER Levels sit on a geothermal gradient - the deeper you dig, the warmer the rock - and deeper levels crawl with more bugs and hide richer ore. Native warren carving runs by default; with Biomes! Caverns loaded, Strata can generate full cavern layouts instead. For a compact shaft, research the powered elevator: a 1x1 car that needs power to descend but always lets colonists ride up if power fails, so no one is trapped below. Empty levels throttle background simulation to protect framerate in a tall base.
PERFORMANCE NOTE: every level is a full map matching your map size, so on LARGE map sizes (300x300 and up) each opened level adds correspondingly more load. A deep base on a big map will cost real performance - the vacant-level and background-level throttles soften it, but if you dig many levels, consider a smaller map size when generating the world.
To move goods between levels, keep a stockpile near the stairs on each floor - colonists haul up and down through the stairwell on their own.
POWER UP AND DOWN THE SHAFTS An elevator automatically ties the two levels' power grids together, and a researched shaft power conduit does the same beside any stairwell - so surface generators can light the deep, and a level's spare power can flow back up. Surplus flows to whichever level runs short; keep a battery on each level for it to pool across.
HOW IT WORKS Each level is a real RimWorld map linked by stairwell pairs. Pathfinding, temperature, rooms, and combat all work per-level exactly like vanilla - Strata's job relay teaches colonist AI to move to the level where they are needed, so everything degrades safely and stays mod-compatible.
TIPS - Thick rock roofs collapse when unsupported: leave pillars in big halls, just like mountain bases. - Stairwells cannot be deconstructed while colonists are still on the linked level. - Raiders who run out of targets on their level will find your stairwells and come down (or up) after you. A sealed stairwell stops them cold - and blocks gas through the shaft - but it stops your colonists too. - Rename levels in the Levels tab so "Level -2" or "Level +1" becomes something you will remember. - Smoke and buoyant gases rise through open stairwells - put burners in a ventilated room, duct fumes to a shaft, or let the stack carry them up.
Requires the Harmony mod. RimWorld 1.6. Odyssey optional (gravship stacks only). Safe to add to existing saves. Before removing from a save: bring everyone to the surface, haul up anything you care about, and deconstruct all stairwells.
